title: Act 3 - Chapter 4: Water Labyrinth, Chrono Island & Rocket Warehouse
synopsis: Use your gift Mareanie to disperse the wild Corsola barricade on Brine Road, unlocking the churning waterways of the Water Labyrinth. Visit Resort Gorgeous to showcase fusions to Lady Selphy for a Master Ball. Land at Chrono Island (Five Island), purchase Heart Scales, and track wild Kecleon with the Poké Radar. Infiltrate the Rocket Warehouse in the eastern meadow, battle a static Klinklang, crush Executive Ariana in a 6 vs 6 syndicate confrontation, and recover the stolen Sapphire to complete Celio's Network Machine.
